name: one-last-chance
description: Minimal iPhone client for connecting to olcRTC through one subscription URL.
author: Ruslan Khasanshin

scripts.test: tsx --test src/**/*.test.ts && cd native/one-last-chance-runtime && go test -race ./...
scripts.lint: prettier -u -c . && eslint --cache --cache-location .cache/eslint --cache-strategy content --max-warnings 0 . && shfmt -d scripts/*.sh && bunx shellcheck scripts/*.sh && xcrun swift-format lint --recursive modules/olcrtc-vpn/ios native/olcrtc-tunnel-core/Sources targets/networkpackettunnel && cd native/one-last-chance-runtime && golangci-lint fmt --diff && golangci-lint run
scripts.lint:fix: prettier -u -w . && eslint --cache --cache-location .cache/eslint --cache-strategy content --max-warnings 0 --fix . && shfmt -w scripts/*.sh && xcrun swift-format format --in-place --recursive modules/olcrtc-vpn/ios native/olcrtc-tunnel-core/Sources targets/networkpackettunnel && cd native/one-last-chance-runtime && golangci-lint fmt && golangci-lint run --fix
scripts.check:deps: cd native/one-last-chance-runtime && go mod tidy -diff && go mod verify
scripts.check:vulns: bun audit --prod --audit-level=high --ignore GHSA-5p2g-fcmc-qvqq --ignore GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr && cd native/one-last-chance-runtime && go tool govulncheck ./...
scripts.check: bun lint && bun check:hooks && bun check:workflows && bun check:renovate && bun check:expo && bun check:types && bun check:deps && bun run test && bun check:unused && bun check:vulns && bun run build
scripts.prepare: if [ -n "${CI:-}" ] || [ "${LEFTHOOK:-}" = "0" ]; then exit 0; fi; lefthook install
